website_meta_description: Looking for original surface pattern designs for your next collection? Saltbox Printhouse creates exclusive textile print designs for the fashion and lifestyle industry. Next to our own print collection we also create custom artworks and illustrations for our clients. We are located in Den Haag, NL

Looking for original artwork for your next collection? Have a look in The Print Shop More About The Studio Our Philosophy Finding the perfect textile print for your collection is crucial for your brand's next commercial success. We know how it works and can make your life as a designer or brand-owner a little more fun and easy by taking care of all the details. With our massive love for all that's print and pattern, we are always excited to create new motifs, play around with unexpected color combinations and our guilty pleasure is creating the perfect repeat. All our designs are created by hand and will never travel to it's new owner before it's 100% ready for production and meets our client's wishes. 1/5 New in The Print Shop: "We've been working on new fun artworks for our Spring/Summer '25 collection, from a loose brush floral theme, to soft flowy abstracts and retro floral inspired prints." The Print Shop We have our collection of exclusive prints available in our private client area for design professionals, so you don't need to leave your desk to find the perfect print for your collection. Print files will be immediately ready for download after your purchase. We care about quality, so all our files are high res .PSD or .AI files, color indexed or in separate layers so your team can easily adjust colors and ALL our prints are always delivered in perfect repeat. We can always help you with scales or adjusting colorways as well, just send us a message. SHOP HERE Testimonials “Working with Tessa is really fun and easy. She listens carefully to your needs, has a great eye for sophisticated design and will not stop 'till you are completely satisfied with the end result.” - Magali Marino, O'Neill - “Discovering Saltbox Printhouse while on the hunt for print trends was the best. High quality prints in a unique style, with attention to detail and a wonderful use of colour.” - Isabel Wharton, WGSN - “Working with Tessa was a great experience. Her creativity, ability to translate directions, combined with excellent communication and professionalism, makes the print developments run smooth and productive. --> Saltbox Printhouse | Textile Design Studio | Artwork & Illustration top of page Home The Studio Creative Services For Designers The Print Shop (B2B) Wallpaper & Fabric More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. Meet the studio Made near salt & sea Just a few steps away from the beach in Scheveningen (NL), we create contemporary textile print designs with great attention to detail, trend and quality. We are a dedicated boutique design studio who chooses quality over quantity. We have the know-how of the fast-paced fashion industry and do maintain a solid work-ethic (which means we always strive to work for the best possible result within the given time frame), but more importantly, we stay true to our own aesthetics and stay connected to our inner artist. We do follow trends, but are not limited by them. We are aware of the next commercial colour schemes that will enter stores, but pick the ones that makes our drawings stand out. We work with fashion, interior and lifestyle brands to help them develop outstanding print collections that meets their commercial and artistic values. ​ ​ How it all started The studio was founded by Tessa de Guytenaer in late 2018. Tessa graduated as a textile designer in 2007 from the Royal Academy of Arts The Hague. After working in the fashion, home & sportswear industry for years as an in-house designer, she decided it was time to focus on what truly inspired her and create a more truthful life following her own design path and beliefs. Creating artworks that reflected her style and artistic vision, but weren't restricted by the end product. Having more freedom to go explore the world next to designing, doing that yoga teacher training that was on the list for a long time and spending more time in nature gave her more inspiration and energy than ever to create beautiful prints. ​ Saltbox Printhouse was born, to share the love for print & pattern with other like-minded creatives, to collaborate with inspiring brands and designers, and to live a meaningful life following your true rhythm. Tessa runs the design studio, working with a small group of talented print designers. She lives with her partner and daughters Loïs and Isa near the beach in Scheveningen. ​ Testimonials “Working with Tessa is really fun and easy. She listens carefully to your needs, has a great eye for sophisticated design and will not stop 'till you are completely satisfied with the end result.” - Magali Marino, O'Neill - “Discovering Saltbox Printhouse while on the hunt for print trends was the best. High quality prints in a unique style, with attention to detail and a wonderful use of colour.” - Isabel Wharton, WGSN - “Working with Tessa was a great experience. Her creativity, ability to translate directions, combined with excellent communication and professionalism, makes the print developments run smooth and productive. I highly recommend working with Tessa. ” - Esther Boskaljon, Hunkemöller - Are you a print lover & buyer? Sign up for trend and collection updates and receive 10% discount on your first order! The Print Shop SHOP OUR EXCLUSIVE PRINT LIBRARY With 800+ exclusive artworks to choose from, handmade by our team of talented print artists, you will always find a design for your brand you'll fall in love with! Explore our large collection of beautiful artworks that will give the finishing touch to your swim, beach, resort, RTW or home collection . Led by our artistic vision and commercial know-how, we always have print designs ready for you that are created by great attention to detail, according to the latest WGSN color and print trends in your market. Go to the shop and sign up for your free account! Work with us Job Openings -APPLICATIONS CLOSED- Freelance print designer (remote, working from home) We are looking for a talented freelance print designer with 3+ years of experience as a print designer for fashion and/or home textiles. ​ You: - are highly skilled in painting, hand drawing and digital design - are a PS and AI nerd and Adobe CC has no secrets for you - have 3+ years of experience working as an in-house, print studio or freelance print designer in the fashion or home industry - follow the current trends and know exactly what's happening in the market - are detail-oriented, precise and won't stop until you get the perfect repeat - have a modern, fresh and unique yet commercial style that fits the Saltbox collection - love to work independently, work fast, have a solid work ethic and always meet deadlines on time ​ This sounds like you? We'd love to hear from you! Send your latest and best portfolio work + short intro to tessa@saltboxprinthouse.com ​ * we only work with freelance designers on consignment basis - if this is not what you're looking for, please don't apply ;) Collaborations Do you have an idea for a collaboration with us and your brand? We are always open for fun collabs with inspiring brands that make a difference or stand out in some way. We'd love to grab a coffee and discuss your ideas, just send us a message!
